notes: Each row represents a distinct food item as consumed in a cereal context. The numeric FFQ_FOOD value is used as a unique concept_code, while the descriptive VALUE string becomes the concept_name. The concepts belong to the Dietary_Food domain and are stored in a local NHANES_FOOD vocabulary. No additional columns are present to be treated as synonyms.
harmonization_reasoning: Both datasets represent food items and are already assigned to the Dietary_Food domain and the Food concept class. To avoid fragmentation, we consolidate them into a single, generic NHANES_FOOD vocabulary, which is the broader of the two vocabularies and can accommodate all food concepts from both years.
domain_id_correction_note: Changed from 'Dietary_Food' to 'Observation' -- 'Food' is not a real OMOP CDM 5.3 domain (verified against official OHDSI CommonDataModel docs); the LLM's earlier claim that it was a built-in domain was incorrect.
